definitions.explanation: A kitchen tool with a rough surface used to grate foods like ginger, daikon radish, or wasabi.

examples.japanese: おろし{金|がね}で{大根|だいこん}をおろす。
examples.english: I grate daikon radish with a grater.

examples.japanese: {生姜|しょうが}をおろすのに{小|ちい}さいおろし{金|がね}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: I use a small grater to grate ginger.

examples.japanese: おろし{金|がね}は{使|つか}った{後|あと}すぐに{洗|あら}う。
examples.english: I wash the grater right after using it.

notes:
FORMATION:
おろし (grating) + {金|がね} (metal)

ALTERNATE WRITING:
Also written as {卸し金|おろしがね} or {下ろし金|おろしがね}.

TYPES:
・{鬼|おに}おろし - coarse grater (for rough texture)
・{銅製|どうせい}おろし{金|がね} - copper grater (traditional, fine)
・セラミックおろし{金|がね} - ceramic grater

COLLOCATIONS:
・おろし{金|がね}でおろす - to grate with a grater
・{大根|だいこん}おろし - grated daikon
・{薬味|やくみ}をおろす - to grate condiments

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese graters often have a circular design with fine teeth, different from Western box graters.
